entries.title: Hosea 14:1
segments: ¶O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.

entries.title: Hosea 14:2
segments: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive [us] graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips. {receive...: or, give good}

entries.title: Hosea 14:3
segments: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, [Ye are] our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.

entries.title: Hosea 14:4
segments: ¶I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.

entries.title: Hosea 14:5
segments: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon. {grow: or, blossom} {cast...: Heb. strike}

words.text: I will be as the dew

entries.title: Hosea 14:6
segments: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon. {spread: Heb. go}

words.text: shall be as the olive tree

entries.title: Hosea 14:7
segments: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive [as] the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof [shall be] as the wine of Lebanon. {grow: or, blossom} {scent: or, memorial}

entries.title: Hosea 14:8
segments: ¶Ephraim [shall say], What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard [him], and observed him: I [am] like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.

words.text: [shall say], What have I to do any more with idols

entries.title: Hosea 14:9
segments: Who [is] wise, and he shall understand these [things]? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD [are] right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
